ordered_attempts.question: Two bulbs in series
ordered_attempts.response: Bulb 1 uses up current so Bulb 2 gets less

ordered_attempts.question: Three resistors in series
ordered_attempts.response: Current through R3 is smaller than R1 because current is consumed

ordered_attempts.question: Swapped order probe
ordered_attempts.response: The first resistor in line always gets more current

ordered_attempts.question: Adding 3-ohm in parallel to 6-ohm
ordered_attempts.response: Total current stays 2A because battery output is fixed
ordered_attempts.diagnosis: MISC-ELEC-002: Battery as Constant Current Source

ordered_attempts.question: Adding 5 more branches
ordered_attempts.response: Battery current is constant, just divided
ordered_attempts.diagnosis: MISC-ELEC-002: Battery as Constant Current Source

ordered_attempts.question: PhET ray simulation step

ordered_attempts.question: Proton near North pole
ordered_attempts.response: Proton repelled because North pole is positive charge
ordered_attempts.diagnosis: MISC-MAG-001: Magnetic Pole = Electrostatic Charge Fallacy

ordered_attempts.question: Electron near South pole
ordered_attempts.response: Electron repelled because South pole is negative charge
ordered_attempts.diagnosis: MISC-MAG-001: Magnetic Pole = Electrostatic Charge Fallacy

ordered_attempts.question: Cannot see blackboard at 5m
ordered_attempts.response: Myopia, needs convex lens to magnify distant objects
ordered_attempts.diagnosis: MISC-EYE-001: Vision Defect Corrective Lens Inversion

ordered_attempts.question: POE ray trace simulation
ordered_attempts.response: Eye lens is over-converging in front of retina, convex lens makes it worse. Needs concave lens!

ordered_attempts.question: Reassessment: Far point 1.5m
ordered_attempts.response: Prescribe concave lens of focal length -1.5m

ordered_attempts.question: Concave mirror u = 20, f = 15
ordered_attempts.response: u = 20, f = 15 gives v = +60cm virtual image
ordered_attempts.diagnosis: MISC-OPT-004: Cartesian Sign Convention Spatial Inversion

ordered_attempts.question: Convex lens u = 30, f = 10
ordered_attempts.response: u = +30cm because distance is positive length
ordered_attempts.diagnosis: MISC-OPT-004: Cartesian Sign Convention Spatial Inversion
